what: Reading the entry code showed `fn main(x: u32) {}` compiled and ran with `x` whatever was in the first argument register: nothing checked `main`'s parameters (rustc's E0580).
cause: `start_shim` stores `main`'s address as a `fn() -> T` without comparing signatures, and blaze-diagnostics' `entry` check stops at finding a function
fix: fixed on this branch: `hir_ty::entry::takes` refuses a `main` with parameters outside the blaze edition (crates/blaze-diagnostics/src/checks/krate.rs)
